 Trent Williams and Dre Greenlaw will play today
 ﻿Cornerbacks Renardo Green, Deommodore Lenoir, and Upton Stout are all active.
 by Kyle Posey Nov 15, 2026, 8:11 PM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 The San Francisco 49ers’ inactive list is out ahead of their matchup against the Dallas Cowboys:
 QB Kurtis Rourke
WR Mike Evans
OL Enrique Cruz Jr.
LB Tatum Bethune
WR Brandin Cooks
 Deebo Samuel returning to the lineup means one of the receivers would be inactive. And since Jacob Cowing offers value on special teams, that means Cooks, who was originally on the practice squad, loses a spot on game day.
 So it’ll be Demarcus Robinson, Deebo, Jordan Watkins, Keenan Allen, and Cowing as Brock Purdy’s targets against Dallas.
 After suffering injuries during Thursday’s practice, Trent Williams and Dre Greenlaw are in uniform.
 One week after being inactive, Khalid Kareem will be among the active edge rushers. He’ll join Nick Bosa, Keion White, Romello Height, and Mykel Williams.
 Kareem likely plays early downs, perhaps the snaps Gracen Halton would have played. Then, on passing downs, that’s when players like White might be asked to do more.
 Cornerbacks Renardo Green, Deommodore Lenoir, and Upton Stout are all active. They’ll be tested against a passing attack like the Cowboys’.
